title: Innokin MVP Replacement Pods 0.65ohm - 3 Pack
description: The MVP kit from Innokin uses these refillable pods which have an e-liquid capacity of 2ml and fixed 0.65 ohm coils that allow for multiple refills. When it is time to top up with e-liquid, simply release the silicon stopper and refill the pod with your favourite e-liquid. When your pod starts to lose flavour, simply swap it out for a new one. The MVP pods from Innokin are best used with N ic Salt , 50/50 and classic High-PG E-Liquids. This pack contains 3 x replacement Innokin MVP pods, 2ml. The MVP pod kit from Innokin is the ideal kit for newer vapers thanks to a vaping experience that closely mimics that of taking a puff on a traditional cigarette. It’s also an incredibly lightweight and discreet solution for any vaper looking for an easy-to-carry and hassle-free vape.
